input.summary: Insert vendor insurance provision in General Provisions
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance provision even though Kubient collects, stores and manages visitor data and serves ads on our Properties, so we have added a short insurance paragraph at our preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where our data is handled, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). If limits are an issue, we can fall back to E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M.

ops.text: Kubient shall maintain throughout the Term: (i) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (ii) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (iii) where Kubient processes, stores or otherwise handles any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and (iv) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable Law. Kubient shall provide certificates of insurance to Customer on request.
